scope: Reference A r1 static eight-view reconstruction only; no Reference B approval, source-mesh identity, runtime, owner-selection or native-turntable claim.

sources.role: Primary clear whole-tree source newly available after r1 generation; visible taper, tabs, contour and trunk.
Generation primary; visible pointed cap, overlapping tiers and tiny trunk.
Steeper source camera; close evidence of broad flat polygonal cut tabs and dark thin contour.
Corroborating whole-tree architecture from a steeper camera.

inspection.evidence_operation: Original-pixel candidate crops and contact arrangement only; candidate and source files unchanged.

scores.score_basis: Scores are scoped visual judgments, not measured percent matches; failures are not averaged away.

mandatory_checks.evidence: Exact SHA256 verified; native 1536 x 1024 RGB.

mandatory_checks.requirement: All eight requested azimuth labels and images
mandatory_checks.evidence: 0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270 and 315 degrees are present and separately inspected.

mandatory_checks.requirement: Complete silhouettes with visible short trunks
mandatory_checks.evidence: No clipped tips, skirts or trunks; no occluding reference UI.

mandatory_checks.requirement: Exactly three overlapping blue canopy tiers in every view
mandatory_checks.evidence: All eight drawings retain the defining three-tier construction.
Icy-blue crowns and short red-brown trunk are retained; no green foliage or new decoration.

mandatory_checks.requirement: Broad cut-tab family rather than many small teeth
mandatory_checks.evidence: Family-level character is recognizably Reference A; this does not establish exact tab geometry.
F01: the candidate regularizes several tab ends into smooth rounded fan arcs rather than the flatter, angular, irregular plate ends in A61/A52/A24.
F02: soft rounded volume shading and a highly continuous dark outline remain more illustrative than the restrained faceted surfaces/thin contour of the source.

mandatory_checks.requirement: Pointed upper cap rather than round bush
mandatory_checks.evidence: The cap remains clearly pointed in all eight views.

mandatory_checks.requirement: Plausible static cross-view family, scale and tier consistency
mandatory_checks.evidence: No missing tier or gross size/identity jump was found. Exact rotating notch topology is not established by this static-sheet check.
Footer says reconstruction from reference footage; sheet makes no 4K or 100-percent original-geometry claim.
Readable labels, generous separation and neutral background; no added ground props or video interface.

findings.confidence: high for edge-treatment difference; exact source-hidden topology remains unknown
findings.title: Flatten and de-regularize the cut-tab ends to the visible source profile
findings.observation: Several candidate hems, especially the 180/225-degree middle rims and the lower skirts, read as smooth rounded fan/scallop arcs. The supplied original A crops show broader planar polygonal tabs with flatter ends, sharper changes of direction and deliberately uneven lengths. The family is right, but these visible edges have been redesigned/simplified.
findings.targeted_fix: Use A61 as the clear visible-face primary and A24 as edge-detail corroboration. Match the visible flat plate ends and irregular notch depths/spacing before reconstructing the unseen faces. Keep the three-tier identity, small trunk and eight-view layout; do not substitute Reference B narrow-incision geometry.

findings.confidence: medium-high; source footage resolution/compression limits exact shader comparison
findings.title: Reduce the polished illustration treatment
findings.observation: The candidate uses softly bulging, continuously shaded crown surfaces and a highly uniform dark navy contour. Source A61/A52/A24 has more restrained planar/faceted changes and a thinner, less uniformly emphasized edge. This changes the visible game-asset treatment even though the colors are close.
findings.targeted_fix: Use restrained broad planar blue shading and thin source-like contour edges. Avoid adding strong glossy lighting, plump crown volume or a uniformly inked cartoon outline. Judge the repair beside the original pixels, not against the r1 illustration alone.

non_findings_and_limits: Do not call overall width alone a proven defect: A24 has a much steeper apparent camera than A61/A52, and source perspective changes the apparent height/width.
No conclusive impossible cross-view geometry was established. The sheet is visually plausible as one family, but its notch topology cannot be proven to arise from a single rotating 3D mesh.
Original footage does not expose every hidden surface at every azimuth. The unseen side drawings are coherent reconstruction proposals and cannot receive 100-percent source-geometry certification.
Video compression, source pixel count and different rendered presentation prevent an honest pixel-identical or exact-shader certification.
No source asset, runtime model, rig, native scene, gameplay-scale or owner-selection approval is included.

repair_and_retest.next_action: Make one focused r2 repair using A61 plus A24 source evidence; preserve r1 as an unselected iteration. Reinspect the exact resulting bytes against all four original crops and all eight views.
preserve: Broad irregular Reference A cut-tab family
repair_and_retest.acceptance: All mandatory checks pass and visible reference-sensitive score reaches at least 9.9; hidden source geometry remains explicitly unverified.
